_meta.title: Apple iPhone & iPad color map (ProductType -> marketing colors)
_meta.source: AppleDB (https://appledb.dev) - colors compiled from per-device API data

schema.devices: Map keyed by lockdownd ProductType (e.g. 'iPhone17,1'). Each entry: name, type, released (first release date), models (Apple model numbers, may be partial for some iPad cellular variants), colors[{name, hex}].
schema.hex: #RRGGBB. A few older devices have two values [primary, secondary tone] as Apple's artwork used two-tone finishes.

usage_notes: Read ProductType via lockdownd (ideviceinfo -k ProductType), then look it up here to get the possible colors for that device.

DeviceColor/DeviceEnclosureColor from lockdownd is inconsistent: old devices return names ('black'), 2014-2017 devices return hex strings ('#e1e4e3'), iPhone XR and newer return a numeric enum ('1'). The numeric enum is model-specific and NOT mapped here.

For exact color identification on newer devices, match the Apple model number (e.g. A3083, from ModelNumber + RegionInfo) against a per-color model list - every color/storage/region combo has its own part number.
To update for new devices: add a new entry under 'devices', or re-pull from https://api.appledb.dev/device/<ProductType>.json
enclosureCodes sources: 3uTools devices_table (authoritative, verified against two physical devices), FutureTap community spreadsheet, libimobiledevice #818.
